name: infinite-physics-gallery
title: Infinite Physics Gallery
description: Infinite 2-D draggable grid with physics-based momentum, edge scrolling, and support for mixed image/video cells. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-kit/infinite-physics-gallery-element.ts";
---

<motion-infinite-physics-gallery
  items='[{"type":"image","src":"/1.jpg"},{"type":"image","src":"/2.jpg"}]'
  cell-width="320"
  cell-height="400"
  class="h-[480px] w-full rounded-2xl overflow-hidden"
></motion-infinite-physics-gallery>
